name: Grid Gradient Normal Estimation
aliases: Grid Gradient Normal Estimation — Finite Difference Normals, Gradient-Based Normals
definition: A technique to compute vertex normals by estimating the gradient of the underlying scalar field (density/potential function) at grid vertices using finite differences, then interpolating these normals to the mesh vertices.
summary: Grid Gradient Normal Estimation computes vertex normals by estimating the gradient of the underlying scalar field using finite differences, differing from face-normal averaging by sampling the density function directly.
